issue_request: FHIR-5876 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 Patient Care. It asked why AllergyIntolerance.recorder was defined as the responsible person and requested clearer wording: "Individual who recorded the record and takes responsibility for its content".
initial_application: SVN/git commit 2b23bf322d (SVN #5122) initially applied the issue by changing the old AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet definition from responsibility-only wording to the requested recorded-and-responsible wording.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. The current source is source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml, where later recorder work retained the FHIR-5876 meaning, added recorder/recordedDate contrast comments, temporarily replaced recorder with participant, then restored recorder. FHIR-48804 later refined the same definition to responsibility for accurately recording content. FHIR-49653 is related but Triaged/unresolved and does not override applied source.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active AllergyIntolerance.recorder definition already satisfies FHIR-5876, so editing it back to the older exact wording would discard a later approved clarification.
